principles: temporal self-class rotation in frozen covariance-aware geometry
native class-balanced competition and local prior retained
no raw-mean unit target or ETF
support and age are heuristics, not calibrated confidence

constants.parameter_selection: prospective mathematical CPU design; no val selection

target.reference: task-start full native head with current new classes bootstrapped from native fit statistics
target.curvature: G0=sum(Q0)/K + .001 R0; frozen at task start
target.rotation: minimum plane rotation between before/current directions, angle multiplied by rho_c
target.age: tasks since class introduction; old evidence remains transport estimate
target.degenerate: zero or antipodal unidentified plane: rho=0 and exact reference column
target.refresh: epoch boundary fit-only statistics; detached and fixed within each optimization block; all-current boundary statistics join only at native seal
target.old_mean_transport: existing shared translation only; no new old-image estimator

objective.native_proximal: .01 during minibatch solve retained; boundary native proximal=0
objective.gradients: envelope derivative of fixed-target block; target refresh is not differentiated
objective.zero: lambda=0 or all rho=0 calls native solve exactly

complementary_to_local_transport: local_transport maintains regional prior; anchor acts on temporal global classifier contrasts without adding region centers or transporting statistics again

planned_comparisons.essential_contribution: same lambda/rho, target A=W0 static task-start anchor versus rotated target
secondary_if_authorized: support/age weighting contribution using same target and strength
covariance-aware direction versus raw Euclidean direction
planned_comparisons.execution: not authorized now; dynamic adapter-training effect cannot be represented by final-checkpoint inference-only evaluation
planned_comparisons.primary: local_transport; never select a best control with val
planned_comparisons.development_gates: paired control: BA>=+1pp, tail>=-.5pp, forgetting<=+1pp, old/new>=-1pp on both datasets; per-class damage retained, no statistical-significance claim

future_budget_only.optimizer: AdamW .0003 WD .01, per-task cosine; FD10 clip5
